legacy_subject_mappings_failure_code_che.name: legacy_subject_mappings_failure_code_check
legacy_subject_mappings_failure_code_che.value: (("legacy_subject_mappings"."state" IN ('AMBIGUOUS', 'FAILED') AND "legacy_subject_mappings"."mapping_failure_code" IS NOT NULL) OR ("legacy_subject_mappings"."state" NOT IN ('AMBIGUOUS', 'FAILED') AND "legacy_subject_mappings"."mapping_failure_code" IS NULL))

legacy_subject_mappings_verified_at_chec.name: legacy_subject_mappings_verified_at_check
legacy_subject_mappings_verified_at_chec.value: (("legacy_subject_mappings"."state" = 'VERIFIED' AND "legacy_subject_mappings"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("legacy_subject_mappings"."state" <> 'VERIFIED' AND "legacy_subject_mappings"."verified_at" IS NULL))

operations_credentials_lifecycle_check.name: operations_credentials_lifecycle_check
operations_credentials_lifecycle_check.value:
("operations_credentials"."status" = 'active' and "operations_credentials"."revoked_at" is null)
        or ("operations_credentials"."status" = 'revoked' and "operations_credentials"."revoked_at" is not null)

service_principals_kind_discriminator_ch.name: service_principals_kind_discriminator_check
service_principals_kind_discriminator_ch.value:
(
        ("service_principals"."kind" = 'provider_service' and "service_principals"."provider_id" is not null and "service_principals"."system_id" is null)
        or
        ("service_principals"."kind" = 'platform_system' and "service_principals"."provider_id" is null and "service_principals"."system_id" is not null)
      )
